from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,re,hashlib,unicodedata
import pandas as pd
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
ROOT=Path.cwd();R='reports/research/510300_original_survey_information_cutoff_population_v1';OUT=ROOT/R
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def readj(p):return json.loads((ROOT/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save(n,o):
 p=OUT/n;assert not p.exists(),'已有来源结果不覆盖：'+n
 p.write_text(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
proto=readj(R+'/protocol.json')
for z in proto['parents']:assert sha(ROOT/z['path'])==z['sha256']
refs=readj('reports/research/510300_employment_delivery_cause_increment_v1/全部132月就业配送原文绑定.json');assert len(refs)==132
pattern=re.compile(r'(?:截至|截止)(20\d{2})年(\d{1,2})月(\d{1,2})日[，,：:]?(?:采购经理调查结果(?:显示)?|采购经理调查(?:结果)?显示|调查结果显示)')
records=[]
for k,z in enumerate(refs):
 p=ROOT/z['raw_path'];assert sha(p)==z['raw_sha256']
 soup=BeautifulSoup(p.read_bytes(),'html.parser');text=re.sub(r'\s+','',unicodedata.normalize('NFKC',soup.get_text(' ')))
 title=soup.title.get_text(' ',strip=True) if soup.title else ''
 matches=[]
 for mm in pattern.finditer(text):
  y,m,d=map(int,mm.groups())
  date=pd.Timestamp(year=y,month=m,day=d).date()
  matches.append({'date_upper_bound':str(date),'same_original_stat_month':str(pd.Period(date,freq='M'))==z['stat_month'],'anchor':text[max(0,mm.start()-35):mm.end()+160],'scope':'采购经理调查结果整体'})
 dates={a['date_upper_bound'] for a in matches if a['same_original_stat_month']}
 whole_valid=bool(matches) and all(a['same_original_stat_month'] for a in matches) and len(dates)==1
 cutoff=next(iter(dates)) if whole_valid else None
 extra=[text[max(0,mm.start()-25):mm.start()+200] for mm in re.finditer(r'截至|截止|调查时点|调查时间',text)]
 records.append({'stat_month':z['stat_month'],'source_url':z['source_url'],'raw_path':z['raw_path'],'raw_sha256':z['raw_sha256'],'published_at':z['published_at'],'available_at':z['available_at'],'original_title':title,'survey_latest_information_date_upper_bound':cutoff,'status':'EXPLICIT_ORIGINAL_SURVEY_RESULT_AS_OF_DATE_UPPER_BOUND' if cutoff else 'UNKNOWN_NOT_ESTABLISHED_UNDER_FIXED_ORIGINAL_FIELD_CONTRACT','candidate_anchors':matches,'other_possible_cutoff_terms_not_auto_admitted':list(dict.fromkeys(extra)),'date_precision':'DATE_UPPER_BOUND' if cutoff else 'UNKNOWN','not_assumed_release_or_month_end_date':True,'first_historical_vintage_authenticated':False,'firm_level_exact_survey_clock':'UNKNOWN'})
 if (k+1)%44==0:print('已读原当前月信息覆盖来源：'+str(k+1)+'/132',flush=True)
save('全部132原当前月_显式调查资料上界与未知.json',records)
by={z['stat_month']:z for z in records}
members=pd.read_csv(ROOT/'reports/research/510300_official_joint_cause_full_original_population_v1/全部1711原当前成熟成员_原因来源与原决定钟.csv',usecols=['idx','stat_month','decision_time'])
assert len(members)==1711 and members.stat_month.nunique()==86
rows=[]
for z in members.itertuples(index=False):
 q=by[z.stat_month];decision=pd.Timestamp(z.decision_time);available=pd.Timestamp(q['available_at'])
 assert available<=decision
 cutoff=q['survey_latest_information_date_upper_bound'];known=cutoff is not None
 age=(decision.date()-pd.Timestamp(cutoff).date()).days if known else None
 rows.append({'idx':int(z.idx),'stat_month':z.stat_month,'decision_time':z.decision_time,'original_published_available_at':q['available_at'],'original_public_clock_still_passed':True,'survey_latest_information_date_upper_bound':cutoff,'coverage_upper_bound_known':known,'decision_minus_coverage_upper_bound_calendar_days':age,'date_difference_not_exact_hour_age':True,'all_original_members_kept':True})
pd.DataFrame(rows).to_csv(OUT/'全部1711原成员_公布可知钟与调查覆盖上界.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
memberby={z['idx']:z for z in rows}
pools=readj('reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/共同成熟训练池.json');assert len(pools)==1212
scores=[]
for z in pools:
 ids=[int(i) for i in z['training_indices']];i=int(z['idx']);allids=[i]+ids
 known=sum(memberby[j]['coverage_upper_bound_known'] for j in allids)
 scores.append({'idx':i,'n_original_mature':len(ids),'current_coverage_known':memberby[i]['coverage_upper_bound_known'],'known_current_and_mature_uses':known,'unknown_current_and_mature_uses':len(allids)-known,'all_original_members_kept':True,'all_cutoff_support_complete':known==len(allids)})
pd.DataFrame(scores).to_csv(OUT/'全部1212原评分日_覆盖字段支持保留全部成员.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
known=[z for z in records if z['survey_latest_information_date_upper_bound']]
usedmonths=sorted(set(members.stat_month));usedknown=[z for z in known if z['stat_month'] in usedmonths]
knownmembers=[z for z in rows if z['coverage_upper_bound_known']]
result={'study_id':proto['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E68','completed_at':now(),'status':'COMPLETED_EXPLICIT_SURVEY_INFORMATION_CUTOFF_FULL_ORIGINAL_POPULATION_MISSING_MODEL_NOT_RUN',
'classification':'PROGRESS_E68_FULL_ORIGINAL_INFORMATION_COVERAGE_SOURCE_SUPPORT_MAPPED',
'original_reports':132,'original_explicit_cutoff_reports':len(known),'original_cutoff_not_established_reports':132-len(known),'all_explicit_original_months':[{'stat_month':z['stat_month'],'date_upper_bound':z['survey_latest_information_date_upper_bound']} for z in known],
'used_stat_months':86,'used_explicit_cutoff_months':len(usedknown),'used_cutoff_unknown_months':86-len(usedknown),'original_unique_current_and_mature_members':1711,'known_cutoff_unique_members':len(knownmembers),'unknown_cutoff_unique_members':1711-len(knownmembers),
'original_score_days':1212,'known_current_score_days':sum(z['current_coverage_known'] for z in scores),'complete_current_and_mature_cutoff_score_pools':sum(z['all_cutoff_support_complete'] for z in scores),'mature_known_cutoff_member_uses':sum(z['known_current_and_mature_uses'] for z in scores),
'known_members_decision_date_minus_latest_cutoff_date_calendar_range':[min(z['decision_minus_coverage_upper_bound_calendar_days'] for z in knownmembers),max(z['decision_minus_coverage_upper_bound_calendar_days'] for z in knownmembers)] if knownmembers else None,
'all_original_public_availability_clocks_still_passed':True,'publication_availability_is_not_measurement_coverage':True,'not_all_report_time_words_are_admitted_cutoffs':True,'official_cutoff_nonexistence_claim':False,
'model_status':'NOT_RUN_SOURCE_CONTRACT_INCOMPLETE_AND_NO_MODEL_CANDIDATE_REGISTERED','previous_models_not_rerun_or_invalidated_by_new_field_missingness':True,'no_default_25th_release_date_or_month_end_fill':True,'new_network_requests':0,'new_labels':0,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'independent_validation':False,'causal_equity_returns':'NOT_IDENTIFIED','net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','goal_achieved':False,'orders_authorized':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','live_process':False,'root_consecutive_blocked_goal_turns':0}
save('result.json',result)
report=['# E68：原全母集的公布可知钟与调查信息覆盖','',
'复查原132当前月基础PMI发布，只准入官方明确连接采购经理调查结果的截至年月日，统计月不同/冲突/对象不同或未提及均UNKNOWN。合同与全文程序先保存，不从表内历史月份、下一期报告或元数据补测量截止，不默认每月25日/公布日/月末。','',
'原本已公布、决定前可知的资料仍按原钟保持；本问题是其经济信息覆盖到了哪里，两种含义分别评价。字段缺失不证明旧公布钟有未来泄漏、不自动否定既有数值比较，旧拒绝也不被重做。','',
'实际全原支持：'+json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False)+'。','',
'明确截止年月日的原页只说明日期上界，不是各企业填表的精确时刻。2020-01特殊调查截至20日/31日公布，不能把该特殊值套其他月，也不能以普通制度的予定日期冒充每个历史月实际覆盖。','',
'全132未准入字段不代表其他真实官方制度/别的文字没有日期。若原月未直接公布，下一只可另登记真正历史适用调查制度的问题，区分制度规定时段和实际数据覆盖；真实版本及春节例外必须保留。当前没有新收益候选/模型/账户。','',
'[固定合同](protocol.json)、[132原上界/未知](全部132原当前月_显式调查资料上界与未知.json)、[1711原成员](全部1711原成员_公布可知钟与调查覆盖上界.csv)、[1212原池](全部1212原评分日_覆盖字段支持保留全部成员.csv)、[结果](result.json)。']
(OUT/'原全调查覆盖_公布时点与经济时点_来源发现.md').write_text('\n'.join(report)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
for z in proto['parents']:assert sha(ROOT/z['path'])==z['sha256']
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False))
